owner: Hypercurve exact path/region corner construction, selected-circle contact and reconstruction; existing CurveRegion2 arrangement and native replay
domain: A selected unit semicircle centered at the retained degree-seven/five point, N=(-4/5,3/5), T=(3/5,4/5), closed by its diameter. Edit the original corner C-N with TrimOnly. Chamfer setbacks are Euclidean chord distances 1/4. Fillet radius is 1/4, with exact center and both contacts explicitly constrained.
independent_chamfer: The circle cut is C-(31/32)N+(sqrt(63)/32)T and the line cut C-(3/4)N. The circle equation and squared chord setback 1/16 follow independently from 31^2+63=1024 and 1+63=64.
independent_fillet: For s=sqrt(1/2), constrain center C-sN+(1/4)T, previous contact C-(4s/3)N+(1/3)T and next contact C-sN. The center has distance 3/4 from C and 1/4 from the diameter; both fillet radii are 1/4 and source tangents agree at the contacts.
missing_acceptance: Reproduce the complete positive corner, exact boundary reconstruction, native path/region replay and round expansion/contraction continuation on the current full circle-line-contacts draft before any production change. Preserve the original corner and contact assertions even when an early stage blocks.
selection: TrimOnly finite domains. A chamfer has exactly one selected pair on the half circle and diameter. The fillet request names its exact center and both contacts, avoiding selection by approximate proximity or candidate order.
limits: The probe uses an external 300-second timeout per full chain; timeout is not a mathematical no-solution or shared-resource exhaustion result. No comparative performance or complete closure claim.
scope: Isolated retained-point/chord and selected-circle corner implementation. Existing parent increments stay frozen.

projection_contract.owner: Hypercurve finite projection closure under P18/P19/P29, using already validated path/contour/region closure.
projection_contract.witness: Unchanged full corner chain fails its filled SVG deterministic replay assertion; both SVG artifacts are retained in corners-recovered-fix4. Native metadata is byte-identical.
projection_contract.rule: Every close_ring caller supplies a proven closed exact curve whose sampler includes its terminal endpoint. Reuse the first finite endpoint for that same exact final vertex instead of appending a second projection. Never infer exact equality from proximity or finite coordinates; keep the exact source authoritative.
projection_contract.shared_vertices: Connected path/region spans and source subdivisions reuse their preceding endpoint projection. The original exact topology authorizes the reuse. Parallel and Bezier segment bounds consume that actual start vertex; circle projection retains its existing sagitta and endpoint allowance. Exact native metadata remains authoritative and byte-identical in the reproduced display-only failure.

circle_constructor_contract: Retain the existing mapped radial frame. For an exact scalar angle on a source with a proved represented radial displacement, evaluate the center in its original joint field and reuse that represented unit normal through the existing chord-normal circle carrier. General retained centers must not be required to expose independent Real coordinates. Only internal construction-certified components create a UnitDirection2 proof; native replay must still validate stored components.
round_join_contract: Use the existing represented_frame_unit_normal authority so represented and certified chord-normal frames share the same contact proof. Retain source normal displacement, radius, policy and angular checks.
fillet_reconstruction_contract: When pair-solve evidence is absent, prove the final contact lies on the constructed exact circle and invert its existing complete-circle chart. Preserve its one/two-half ownership and requested traversal, and publish the original contact through the common reconstruction helper.
endpoint_tangent_contract: Extend the existing exact represented endpoint tangent to every exact scalar angular parameter using the original rational half-chart and shared represented-unit-normal authority, including chord-normal frames. Retain signed radius and traversal. Existing shared-endpoint tangent proof re-establishes uniqueness for distinct circle supports from cross/dot and exact point equality; no serialized success flag or second arrangement.
chord_point_equality_contract: For a procedural chord displacement with certified represented unit tangent and a joint-field or lazy/similarity counterpart, consume the existing source-bound coordinate proof before interval refinement. Retain the procedural definition, guards, policies, and exhaustion; no tolerance or independent-coordinate replacement.
circle_pair_exclusion_contract: The shared point-field predicate signs 4*q*r1²-(q+r1²-r2²)², q=|C2-C1|², with original nonzero coordinate guards and a cleared squared denominator. A strict negative value proves no real support contact and therefore no selected-arc contact. Zero/positive/unsupported cases retain existing intersection authority; actual resource exhaustion propagates. This is not a claim of general intersecting-circle or arbitrary implicit support.
